name: Scott Colom
summary:
Scott Winston Colom ( kə-LOHM; born December 24, 1982) is an American politician, lawyer, and jurist who is a United States senator-elect from Mississippi. A member of the Democratic Party, Colom has served as district attorney for the 16th Judicial District of Mississippi since 2016.
Born and raised in rural Mississippi, Colom graduated from Millsaps College and the University of Wisconsin Law School.
